$comment: Story 4.0 F5 (ADR-148): the walk across a shut city, told — the empty flyover, a milk van, the long walk east; it lands in Indiranagar at 16:57, a minute before the balconies (4.1).

panels.title: HEBBAL FLYOVER · 10:10
panels.text: Empty in both directions. Your footsteps are the loudest thing for a kilometre.

panels.title: MEKHRI CIRCLE · 11:40
panels.text: A milk van slows beside you. "Shivajinagar. Get in. Don't tell anyone I stopped."

panels.title: SHIVAJINAGAR · 13:20
panels.text: Shutters, shutters, shutters. A man hosing a temple's steps stops to watch you pass.

panels.title: INDIRANAGAR · 16:57
panels.text: Your legs have stopped asking. Half an hour more. Then the hill.
